trust_decision.summary: Whether a URI host string is a single well-formed authority host (no userinfo/path/query/fragment/backslash delimiters, no bare port colon, balanced brackets) so that getHost() and the on-wire authority / generated Host header agree; decided in Uri::assertValidHost (shared by Uri parsing, withHost and Request Host generation) and in the IPv6-prefix branch of Uri::parse.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'weak URI host validation'; Uri::assertValidHost is the only host validator in Uri and its regex only rejects control chars/space.

fix_sites.entry_point: new Uri($string) / Utils::uriFor / HttpFactory::createUri / Message::parseRequest absolute-form target (Uri::parse IPv6-prefix branch)
Uri::withHost, Uri::fromParts, new Uri, Request::__construct/withUri via Uri::assertValidHost, ServerRequest::getUriFromGlobals via withHost
same as Uri::assertValidHost callers (new bracket-balance and bare-colon checks appended after line 459)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Request.php:146-160 (Request::updateHostFromUri calls Uri::assertValidHost on an arbitrary UriInterface; fix tests it with a mocked UriInterface, fix.diff:94-112); also src/ServerRequest.php:265-268 (SERVER_NAME/SERVER_ADDR passed to withHost unparsed, tested at fix.diff:125-132)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Request and ServerRequest look like neighbouring features (header generation, server globals); a solver fixing Uri parsing could argue a third-party UriInterface is the caller's responsibility and that HTTP_HOST is already validated by Rfc7230, so SERVER_NAME needs nothing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Bracketed hosts that are not valid IPv6 must keep being accepted and agree between parse and withHost ('[gggg::1]', '[a:b]', '[a]b]', '[]', zone-id '[fe80::1%25eth0]'), plus IDN hosts ('яндекс.рф') and bracketed IPv6 with colons; reusing the stricter Rfc7230 host validator (filter_var IPv6 / IPvFuture) or rejecting every ':' breaks these.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/Rfc7230.php:81-92 (stricter sibling validator) vs fix.diff:237-253 (must-keep-working tests)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Used by redirect middleware for credential stripping; a maintainer would assume hosts are already validated by Uri

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted applyParts/fromParts variant that sets $this->host directly from parts['host'] (e.g. in a normaliser or resolver fast path) bypassing filterHost
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: fromParts is a public lower-level API taking parse_url-shaped arrays; a 'trusted parts' fast path is a plausible optimisation

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resolver/normaliser rebuilding a Uri via withHost on composed components where a planted copy skips filterHost
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UriResolver and UriNormalizer already rebuild URIs from components of other UriInterface instances
